cell.label: Infant with acute excessive crying. Perform history and physical examination. Cause identified?
Assess pattern, observe 1-2 hours.
cell.path: History of recurrent episodes consistent with colic

cell.label: Follow 24 hours in hospital or at home; consider idiopathic crying episode.
Consider: radiologic studies, chemistry tests, pulse oximetry, toxicology tests, and/or lumbar puncture based on history and physical.
Continue observation, in hospital, until crying stops or diagnosis made.

footnotes.footnote: From Barr RG, Hopkins B, Green JA. Crying complaints in the emergency department. Crying as a Sign, a Symptom, and a Signal. London: MacKeith Press; 2000.
